status: WRITTEN BEFORE EXTRACTION - immutable record of the pre-specified protocol
classification: EXPLORATORY PAIRED BENCHMARK. Not independent external validation.

contamination_disclosure.statement: Shenzhen and Montgomery informed the lungs-only masking decision (D09 revisited) that is part of the configuration being evaluated. This cannot be undone retrospectively.
contamination_disclosure.evidence: artifacts/p2/audit/provenance_table.csv row 'D09 revisited -> lung crop'; docs/p2_shortcut_does_not_transfer.md section 'This reopens D09, now on accuracy grounds'
contamination_disclosure.mitigation: Only the WITHIN-PAIR difference between pooling arms is interpreted. Both arms inherit identical contamination, so the difference remains interpretable while neither absolute value is a clean generalisation estimate.
contamination_disclosure.unresolvable: The RAD-DINO model card states the released checkpoint was selected by linear probing on validation sets it does not name. Checkpoint-level exposure to these public benchmarks cannot be excluded for any user of this backbone.

checkpoints_present_at_manifest_time.note: bundle/head.npz has variant full_clahe0 - the OLD configuration (full image, all negatives). It is NOT used as the global arm, because doing so would confound pooling with masking and negative composition. It is preserved untouched.

preprocessing.steps: greyscale -> cv2.resize INTER_AREA to 512x512 -> lungs-only masking (region outside the C05 PSPNet lung mask replaced by the per-image mean) -> RAD-DINO processor
preprocessing.lung_segmenter: torchxrayvision chestx_det PSPNet, same network used for TBX11K and Vietnam

B_patch_mean_1x1.representation: 37x37 patch tokens -> adaptive avg pool to 12x12 -> averaged to 1x1
B_patch_mean_1x1.role: MATCHED CONTROL. Differs from arm C only in the aggregator, so B vs C isolates pooling exactly. Mathematically equivalent to global average pooling of patch tokens.

C_regional_max_12x12.representation: 37x37 patch tokens -> adaptive avg pool to 12x12, L2-normalised per region

head_fitting.negatives: healthy only (per the documented current configuration)
head_fitting.optimizer: AdamW lr 3e-3 wd 1e-4, batch 256, max 120 epochs, patience 15
head_fitting.loss: binary cross-entropy with logit adjustment by the training prior

eligible_case_rules.include: every NLM image with (a) a readable source PNG, (b) a lung mask, (c) a non-empty mask, (d) a label parsable from the filename suffix
eligible_case_rules.exclude_and_report: any image failing the above, listed individually in the report
eligible_case_rules.paired_requirement: arms are scored on the INTERSECTION of cases successfully embedded in all arms; counts reported
eligible_case_rules.label_mapping: filename suffix _1 -> TB positive, _0 -> negative; shz__ prefix = Shenzhen, mcu__ prefix = Montgomery
eligible_case_rules.patient_identity: NLM sets are one image per patient; filename is the patient key

evaluation.no_pooled_headline: Shenzhen and Montgomery are reported separately; Montgomery has 58 positives and pooling would hide its uncertainty
metrics: sensitivity and specificity at a threshold fixed on TBX11K development
confusion matrix at that fixed threshold
paired bootstrap CI for the AUROC difference between arms

bootstrap.method: case resampling with both classes required

evaluation.threshold_provenance: 70% specificity on the TBX11K development split, computed per arm, transferred unchanged. NEVER fitted on Shenzhen or Montgomery.
evaluation.degenerate_groups: reported as unavailable rather than imputed

prohibited_claims: architectural novelty (see PRIOR_ART_AND_NOVELTY.md: RADAR and GLoRI cover frozen-backbone patch aggregation for TB)
permitted_conclusion_shape: Within these cohorts, under identical preprocessing, identical training data and identical seeds, aggregator X scored N points higher/lower than aggregator Y, with paired interval [lo, hi]. Absolute values are not clean generalisation estimates.
